text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'm attending the Yaeno Cheer
Brigade
meet and greet that Yaeno
Muteki invited me to.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everybody, for holding an
event as
wonderful as this in my honor.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If I could ask for a moment of your time,
I wish to
show you something to express
my gratitude for
all of your continued
support.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I will now demonstrate the Eight
Frontiers of the
Kongo Yaegaki style.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
In this exercise, I shall perform every
kata of the
Kongo Yaegaki style, then
spar with the pupils of
the dojo, one
after another.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
At our school, this exercise is performed
by the
assistant instructor. It is said to be
one of the
most challenging
demonstrations of all.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...I have never attempted to do this
before. I'd
like everyone here to bear
witness as I take on
this challenge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A solemn atmosphere settles over the
dojo, and
Yaeno Muteki's expression
becomes one of deep
focus. Her fans
become quiet too, the intensity of
their
expressions matching her concentration.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: Begin!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hya! Hah!
...Hup! Yaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The sounds of Yaeno Muteki's fists and
feet
slicing through the air echo
throughout the dojo.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
The kata are complete! We will now
move to the
sparring. Let the first
opponent step forward!
...Begin!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Pant... Huff... Puff...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki has done well to come
this far, but
with only one opponent left,
her face is marked
with signs of
exhaustion. Just then...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Slip! Thud!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno slips on the sweat of her own feet
and
falls. The sound of her heavy
breathing fills the
room. I lunge forward
to hurry to her side, but—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Fan A
text_block_list.text: Wait! Look at Yaeno's eyes.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(My body feels heavy... I hurt all over...
It's as if
weights have been attached to
my arms and
legs... But...)

text_block_list.name: Dojo Pupil B
text_block_list.text:
So am I! It's like there was a wall in front
of you,
and you smashed through it with
your fighting
spirit! I really respect what
a hard worker you are!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (No matter how resilient the wall, or how fierce the challenge... I will fearlessly face—no, I will smash through it!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That is what I do!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Come at me once more!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: HYAAA!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
That's the end! Yaeno Muteki, your
exhibition of
the Eight Frontiers is now
over, and I hereby
declare that you...
have passed!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Pant... Huff... Pant... ...Everyone.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I will keep... the flame in my heart
burning... and
continue tackling new
challenges... with
boundless energy.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That is what I can show you—what I want to show you all. So, please...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I hope you'll all keep your eyes focused
on me.
...OSU!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Fan A
text_block_list.text:
That's right! She has the strength to
stand back
up and accomplish anything
she sets her mind to!
After all, that's
what makes Yaeno, Yaeno!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Fan A
text_block_list.text:
The fighting spirit in her eyes has ignited
a fresh
wave of passion and
determination in me as well!

text_block_list.name: Dojo Pupil A
text_block_list.text:
I've made up my mind, Yaeno! I'm going
to join
the Yaeno Cheer Brigade!

text_block_list.name: Dojo Pupils
text_block_list.text:
Hey, no fair! I wanna join too!

A-actually, I've been wanting to join for
ages!
Me too! Pleeease let me in!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what?! Well... Th-thank you for your
interest!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki approaches obstacles with
a fiery
heart, and the fans watch over
and cherish her
efforts. It looks like the
blazing bond between
them is only
going to get hotter from here!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Cheer Brigade Leader
text_block_list.text:
You really showed us something amazing
today!
We don't even know how to
thank you!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I hope you'll let us hold another event
soon—one
to celebrate your hard work
and success!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
When that time comes, I will do my best
to put on
another challenging exhibition
that answers the
faith you all have in me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki approaches obstacles with
a fiery
heart, and the fans watch over
and cherish her
efforts. The bond
between them seems dazzlingly
bright.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Cheer Brigade Leader
text_block_list.text:
That was incredible, Yaeno! The Yaeno
Cheer
Brigade is looking forward to
lending you its
continued support.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Cheer Brigade
text_block_list.text: Osu!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki approaches obstacles with
a fiery
heart, and the fans watch over
and cherish her
efforts. Their fiery bond
is overwhelming.
